title: The /discover/events/<slug> twin canonicalised to /events/<slug> but named itself in og:url and its breadcrumb

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-urls and seo-social finders). app/discover/events/[slug]/page.tsx sets alternates.canonical to /events/<slug> and then puts /discover/events/<slug> in openGraph.url and in the BreadcrumbList, so a share and a breadcrumb pointed at the URL the page itself says is not the one. Nothing in app/, components/ or lib/ links to the twin; it is reachable only by its own self-references, and it is prerendered per event with its own OG image route. CLOSED 2026-10-05 for the signal half: og:url and the breadcrumb name the canonical. Retiring the twin (a 308 to /events/:slug and deleting the segment, which also halves the per-event build) is SCAN-672, because it deletes a route and an OG image file two gate tests name.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/discover/events/[slug]/page.tsx","utf8");if(/url: `\/discover\/events\/\$\{event\.slug\}`/.test(s)||/path: `\/discover\/events\/\$\{event\.slug\}`/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-668: /discover/events/<slug> canonicalises to /events/<slug> but its og:url and breadcrumb name the twin, which splits the share and breadcrumb signal across two URLs.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
